description: Replaces Dependabot's version updates, with the same rules Dependabot's version-update config had.

Security fixes stay with Dependabot (alerts and security updates on as GitHub settings; dependabot-auto-merge.yml merges its PRs): it updates vulnerable packages that only appear in package-lock.json, which Renovate's own security PRs do not.

packageRules.description: npm: weekly on Monday, commits as deps(deps) / deps(deps-dev), labelled npm (Dependabot's npm block).
Minor and patch updates travel together, one PR for production and one for development dependencies.

vitest and its companion packages peer-pin each other on an exact version, so a major that arrives as one PR per package can never install (every job dies at npm ci with ERESOLVE). They always travel together, majors included. Listed after the two groups above so it overrides them.

Dependabot never touched package.json overrides: they are hand-kept security floors scoped per major ("uuid@^8.0.0": "^11.1.1"), and a bump would move every package using that line, majors included, with no person looking.
GitHub Actions: weekly on Monday, commits as ci(deps), labelled github-actions; minor and patch updates grouped.

preactjs/compressed-size-action's v3 is an unreleased development branch, not a release (newest release is 2.10.0). Dependabot once bumped onto it and broke the Bundle Size check on every PR. Stay on v2 until a real v3 release exists.
mise: only the Supabase CLI and Node (the rule below groups Node).
Supabase CLI: any time, after a 3-day wait so a bad release can be pulled first.

A Supabase CLI major (like 2.x to 3.x) can change deploy.yml's commands, which no PR check runs, so it waits for a person. Every other update automerges once the required checks pass, as Dependabot's did.

Node's version lives in .mise.toml (and mise.lock), .node-version and every workflow's node-version input. One PR moves them together; the major-only ranges ('26') are kept, and a new major waits for a person.
